    Welcome to ZebraAI

    ZebraAI is a web-based platform that allows you to explore, create, and run artificial intelligence experiments using various data sources. Whether you are a beginner or an expert, you can use ZebraAI to learn more about AI, test your ideas, or develop your skills.

    This guide will help you get started with ZebraAI and show you how to use its features. You will find links to the following topics:

    • Overview of ZebraAI: Learn what ZebraAI is all about.
    • Setting up and Navigating ZebraAI: Learn to find your way around.
    • ZebraAI FAQs: Get your ZebraAI questions answered.

    Developer Resources

    • Developer Setup Guide: Complete local development environment setup instructions.
    • API Documentation: Comprehensive REST API reference with examples.
    • Configuration Guide: Environment configuration, secrets management, and Azure integration.
    • Experiment Types Reference: Complete list of implemented experiment types with Action field mappings.

    Popular ZebraAI Functionality

    • Creating an experiment: Follow the steps to create a new AI experiment from scratch or from a template.
    • Explore Existing Experiments: Learn how to find and use existing and available experiments.
    • Running an existing experiment: Learn how to run your AI experiment and view the results.
    • Editing an existing experiment: Learn how to modify your AI experiment and save your changes.
    • Request CSS Data Usage: Learn how to submit your AI experiment for approval if you want to use CSS data sources.
    • Approval process: Understand the criteria and process for approving AI experiments that use CSS data sources.

    Helpful Videos

    You can find helpful instructional videos and and functionality demonstrations on the ZebraAI Media page.
